arxiv-2011-07546.title: Learning Frame Similarity using Siamese networks for Audio-to-Score Alignment Thanks: This project has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No. 765068.
arxiv-2011-07546.creator: Ruchit Agrawal, Simon Dixon
arxiv-2011-07546.description: Abstract Audio-to-score alignment aims at generating an accurate mapping between a performance audio and the score of a given piece. Standard alignment methods are based on Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) and employ handcrafted features, which cannot be adapted to different acoustic conditions. We propose a method to overcome this limitation using learned frame similarity for audio-to-score alignment.

arxiv-2403-17919.title: LISA: Layerwise Importance Sampling for Memory-Efficient Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
arxiv-2403-17919.creator: Rui Pan, Xiang Liu Shizhe Diao, Renjie Pi, Jipeng Zhang, Chi Han, Tong Zhang
arxiv-2403-17919.description: Abstract The machine learning community has witnessed impressive advancements since large language models (LLMs) first appeared. Yet, their massive memory consumption has become a significant roadblock to large-scale training. For instance, a 7B model typically requires at least 60 GB of GPU memory with full parameter training, which presents challenges for researchers without access to high-resource environments.

arxiv-2406-05539.title: EUV polarimetric diagnostics of the solar corona: the Hanle effect of Ne viii 770 Å
arxiv-2406-05539.creator: Raveena Khan, Sarah E. Gibson, Roberto Casini, K. Nagaraju
arxiv-2406-05539.description: Abstract Magnetic fields are the primary driver of the plasma thermodynamics in the upper solar atmosphere, especially in the corona. However, magnetic field measurements in the solar corona are sporadic, thereby limiting us from the complete understanding of physical processes occurring in the coronal plasma.

arxiv-2409-08438.title: GRAVITY+ Wavefront Sensors: High-Contrast, Laser Guide Star, Adaptive Optics systems for the VLTI
arxiv-2409-08438.creator: Guillaume Bourdarot, Frank Eisenhauer, Şenol Yazıcı, Helmut Feuchtgruber, Jean-Baptiste Le Bouquin, Michael Hartl, Christian Rau, Jonas Graf, Nikhil More, Ekkehard Wieprecht, Frank Haussmann, Felix Widmann, Dieter Lutz, Reinhard Genzel, Frederic Gonté, Sylvain Oberti, Johann Kolb, Julien Woillez, He
arxiv-2409-08438.description: Abstract We present the Wavefront Sensor units of the Gravity Plus Adaptive Optics (GPAO) system, which will equip all 8m class telescopes of the VLTI and is an instrumental part of the GRAVITY+ project. It includes two modules for each Wavefront Sensor unit: a Natural Guide Star sensor with high-order 40x40 Shack-Hartmann and a Laser Guide Star 30x30 sensor.

arxiv-2506-05026.title: Physical Annotation for Automated Optical Inspection: A Concept for In-Situ, Pointer-Based Trainingdata Generation
arxiv-2506-05026.creator: 1 st Oliver Krumpek, 2 nd Oliver Heimann, 3 rd Prof. Jörg Krüger
arxiv-2506-05026.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel physical annotation system designed to generate training data for automated optical inspection. The system uses pointer-based in-situ interaction to transfer the valuable expertise of trained inspection personnel directly into a machine learning (ML) training pipeline.

arxiv-2511-03235.title: From Five Dimensions to Many: Large Language Models as Precise and Interpretable Psychological Profilers
arxiv-2511-03235.creator: Yi-Fei Liu 1 , Yi-Long Lu 2 , Di He *,3,5 , Hang Zhang *,1,4,6,7
arxiv-2511-03235.description: Abstract Psychological constructs within individuals are widely believed to be interconnected. We investigated whether and how Large Language Models (LLMs) can model the correlational structure of human psychological traits from minimal quantitative inputs. We prompted various LLMs with Big Five Personality Scale responses from 816 human individuals to role-play their responses on nine other psychological scales.

arxiv-2512-03009.title: Constraining Zero-Point Length from Gravitational Baryogenesis
arxiv-2512-03009.creator: Ava Shahbazi Sooraki and Ahmad Sheykhi
arxiv-2512-03009.description: Abstract The existence of a fundamental zero-point length, l 0 l_{0} , a minimal spacetime scale predicted by T-duality in string theory or quantum gravity theories, modifies the entropy associated with the horizon of spacetime. In the cosmological setup, this leads to correction to the Friedmann equations governing the evolution of the Universe.

pmc-11498970.title: Cervical Spinal Epidural Hematoma After Spinal Anesthesia for Cesarean Section in the Parturient Using Long-Term Low Dose Aspirin

pmc-11498970.description: Spinal epidural hematoma (SEDH) is a rare but serious complication associated with spinal anesthesia (SA). SUMMARYOBJECTIVE:The aim of the study was to investigate the prevalence of insomnia in postmenopausal osteoporotic women. It also evaluated the relationship between insomnia, fatigue, and mood disorders.METHODS:This cross-sectional study was conducted with 200 postmenopausal osteoporotic women aged 50–75 years.
